async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the issues list page
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Issues", exact=True).first.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: Click the 'New issue' button
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="New issue").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Fill in the issue title
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title (required)", exact=True).fill("Integrating LLMs for better prompts")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for any dynamic updates
    
    # Step 4: Assign the issue to Roshanjossey
    # Look for assignee field; it might be a 'button' with name 'Assignees' or similar
    assignee_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Assignees")
    if await assignee_button.count() > 0:
        await assignee_button.click()
        await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search users").fill("Roshanjossey")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
        await page.get_by_role("option", name="Roshanjossey").click()
    else:
        # Fallback: try 'combobox' with name 'Assign to'
        assignee_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Assign to")
        if await assignee_combobox.count() > 0:
            await assignee_combobox.click()
            await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search users").fill("Roshanjossey")
            await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
            await page.get_by_role("option", name="Roshanjossey").click()
        else:
            print("Assignee field not found; skipping assignment.")
    
    # Step 5: Set the due date to the beginning of Q2 2033 (April 1, 2033)
    due_date_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Due date")
    if await due_date_button.count() > 0:
        await due_date_button.click()
        await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Due date").fill("2033-04-01")
    else:
        due_date_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Due date")
        if await due_date_textbox.count() > 0:
            await due_date_textbox.fill("2033-04-01")
        else:
            print("Due date field not found; skipping due date setting.")
    
    # Step 6: Submit the issue
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Create issue").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
